description: The app's opt-in key (rc4-16): bound at POST /v1/device/token (worker.schema.json $defs/optin_key_bind, member optin_key) only from a device flow the person approved in the browser (never with an enrollment token, never through a route the instance token alone reaches), by bind_signature over "leanctx.cloud.optin_key_bind.v1\n" followed by canonical_json({alg, instance_public_key (the request's string), key_id, public_key, scope: "optin.v1"}); key_id = first 16 hex of sha256(raw public key). It then signs the person's own turn-on of the computer's task pickup only: PUT /v1/me/optin with active true carries presence_signature over "leanctx.cloud.optin.v1\n" followed by canonical_json(body without presence_signature, plus instance_id: the instance UUID in lower case with hyphens) (as optin.vectors.json). The Cloud verifies it against this key only (never the presence key, the chat key or the task-propose key; without a bound opt-in key the turn-on is refused); a chat-key or task-propose-key bind of this key does not verify. Test keys only: opt-in key ed25519 seed = sha256("leanctx-cloud test opt-in key: rc4-16"); instance_public_key = standard base64 of the ed25519 public key of seed sha256("leanctx-cloud test instance key: rc4-67").
